tasks.label: Run WebApp
tasks.command: lsof -ti:5198 | xargs -r kill -9; dotnet watch run --project WebApp

tasks.label: Backup Database (bacpac)
tasks.command: docker run --rm -v ${workspaceFolder}:/app -w /root --network host mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0 /bin/bash -c "dotnet tool install -g Microsoft.SqlPackage && /root/.dotnet/tools/sqlpackage /Action:Export /SourceConnectionString:'Data Source=localhost,1433;Initial Catalog=BigBeerData.Core;User Id=sa;Password=BigBeerStrong2024;TrustServerCertificate=True' /TargetFile:'/app/BigBeerData.backup.bacpac'"

tasks.label: Restore Database (bacpac)
tasks.command: docker exec sqlserver /opt/mssql-tools/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P BigBeerStrong2024 -Q "ALTER DATABASE [BigBeerData.Core] SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE; DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS [BigBeerData.Core]" && docker run --rm -v ${workspaceFolder}:/app -w /root --network host mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0 /bin/bash -c "dotnet tool install -g Microsoft.SqlPackage && /root/.dotnet/tools/sqlpackage /Action:Import /TargetConnectionString:'Data Source=localhost,1433;Initial Catalog=BigBeerData.Core;User Id=sa;Password=BigBeerStrong2024;TrustServerCertificate=True' /SourceFile:'/app/BigBeerData.backup.bacpac'"
